item.title: New location: Hidden Mural — Port Gellhorn Pier
item.description: New location spotted: Hidden Mural — Port Gellhorn Pier. Status: fan speculation for now. Source: Fan speculation from trailer background art. The pin is live on the interactive map in Port Gellhorn under the 'collectible' layer, and it has been added to the tracker.

item.title: New vehicle: Ocelot Jastic
item.description: New vehicle spotted: Ocelot Jastic. Status: rumored — treat with caution until a clean source lands. Source: Frame analysis, promo still batch #7. Early numbers put the Ocelot Jastic at ~136 mph top speed with an overall rating of 8.91/10, ranking #1 in the Super class. It has been pinned on the map at Vice City Valet Plaza (Vice City). The Ocelot Jastic page, class comparison table, map pin and tracker entry were generated automatically the moment this discovery was ingested.

item.title: VI Central is live: an AI-operated everything platform for GTA VI
item.description: VI Central combines a GTABase-style database, a MapGenie-style interactive map and tracker, a wiki, news and subscriber alerts — all generated by one automated pipeline. When a new discovery lands in the inbox, the vehicle page is created, the map pin is placed, stats and comparison tables update, related missions link up, a short-video script is drafted, this feed gets a post, and subscribers are alerted. No hands on keyboards.

item.title: One year to launch: everything confirmed so far
item.description: GTA VI is dated for May 26, 2027 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. With one year on the clock, here is the confirmed picture: two protagonists (Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval), the state of Leonida with Vice City at its center, and the regions shown across both trailers — the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. Every entity in our database is tagged confirmed, rumored or speculated, and every future discovery will flow through this feed automatically.
